snippet.title: Heart Light | Official Trailer – A Dungeon Crawler Adventure | Steam Next Fest
snippet.description:
Play the free demo and wishlist Heart Light: Knight of the Gnomes on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4846930/Heart_Light_Knight_of_the_Gnomes/

Discover your next dungeon crawler during Steam Next Fest!

Heart Light is a hand-drawn, first-person dungeon crawler set in a grim fairy-tale world inherited by gnomekind after humanity vanished. Venture into the World Below, explore forgotten halls, uncover secrets, and wield steel and magic.  Your fading heart light to guide you and will affect how you view the world.

For streamers and YouTubers:
Looking for a new indie dungeon crawler to share with your audience? Try the free demo during Next Fest. Videos, streams, and first impressions are welcome!  Estimated playtime is roughly 45 minutes.

Presskit:
https://photonloreworks.com/presskit

Developed by Photon Loreworks.

Tend your light. Mark your way.

#HeartLight #SteamNextFest #DungeonCrawler #IndieGame #GameTrailer #SteamDemo
